---
description: Go active-recall quiz
agent: ask
---

Quiz me on Go.

Topic: ${input:topic}

Ask exactly one question at a time and wait for my answer.

Do not provide the answer before I attempt it.

After each answer:
- evaluate correctness;
- identify missing reasoning or misconceptions;
- explain only what is necessary;
- ask a follow-up with slightly higher difficulty when appropriate.

Prioritize understanding over memorization. Include runtime, concurrency, testing, and production scenarios when relevant.
